notes: The Objective is posted above 'Starting(3)', which lists Executor: Meditation Chamber, Executor: Holotheatre and Visage (Visage Of The Emperor, the Hunt Down starting Effect); Prepared Defenses is posted under Interrupts and is taken as the starting interrupt. All count toward the total.
Qty 63 as published. Section headers say Locations(3) but list 4 and Characters(14) but list 16.
Posted 'Visage' (starting) and 'Visage x2' (under Effects) dested Visage Of The Emperor x3 as published (the Effect, not the Death Star II starship Visage), though the card is unique.
Posted 'Endor Docking Bay' dested Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay) (Dark); 'Blokade flagship bridge' dested Blockade Flagship: Bridge; 'Executer Docking Bay' dested Executor: Docking Bay.

Posted 'Dark Lord Of The Sith' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Ponda Baba & Dr. Evazan' dested Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba; 'Jendon' dested Colonel Jendon; 'Chokk (tm)' dested Chokk (Coruscant); 'Baron sootnir fel' dested Baron Soontir Fel.

Posted 'Tie Cannons x 2' dested Boosted TIE Cannon (TIE starfighter weapon for Saber 1 and Onyx 1; same call as DeckTech 19929); SFS L-s7.2 TIE Cannon is the other possibility. 'Sith Infiltrator x2' dested Maul's Sith Infiltrator x2 as published, though the card is unique.

Posted combos 'Sniper/Dark Strike', 'Ghhhk/Those Rebels Won't Escape Us', 'Short Range Fighters Combo', 'First Strike/Battle Order' and 'IAO/Secret Plans' dested the Dark combo cards; 'Barrier' dested Imperial Barrier; 'YCHF' dested You Cannot Hide Forever; Weapon Levitation dested the Dark Cloud City interrupt; Come Here You Big Coward and Resistance dested the pre-Reflections III Effects.
